name: King Aeriex
title: The Silver Line
examine: Winter-pale as the high snow, still as the mere. The crown sits on him the way snow sits on the mountain: quietly, heavily, and as if it had always been there.
lines: My grandfather cut the third terrace. My father paved the road you climbed. I sign papers. The Line, you'll notice, is getting comfortable.
The moonpale runs in the Line — my grandmother said the mountain keeps our color so we can't ever deny it's kin.
Ask Kayri anything I just told you. If our answers differ, hers is the true one. That arrangement has never once failed the realm.
